name: CDC BRFSS Diabetes Health Indicators
source: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) - Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System (BRFSS)

features.name: HighBP
features.description: High blood pressure diagnosed by doctor

features.name: CholCheck
features.description: Cholesterol check within the past 5 years

features.name: Smoker
features.description: Have smoked at least 100 cigarettes in life

features.name: HeartDiseaseorAttack
features.description: History of coronary heart disease (CHD) or myocardial infarction (MI)

features.name: PhysActivity
features.description: Physical activity in past 30 days not including job

features.name: Fruits
features.description: Consume fruit 1 or more times per day

features.name: Veggies
features.description: Consume vegetables 1 or more times per day

features.name: HvyAlcoholConsump
features.description: Heavy drinkers (adult men >= 14 drinks/week, women >= 7 drinks/week)

features.name: MentHlth
features.description: Days of poor mental health in past 30 days

features.name: PhysHlth
features.description: Days of poor physical health in past 30 days

features.name: DiffWalk
features.description: Serious difficulty walking or climbing stairs
